---
title: Development
---

Contributors work on the `localmap` R package and its reproducible `{targets}`
workflow. Keep `_targets.R` declarative, put package logic in `R/`, use explicit
package namespaces, keep small fixtures in `inst/extdata/`, and never commit
runtime data or generated outputs.

## Environment

On macOS, install the spatial/runtime libraries once:

```sh
brew install gdal geos proj udunits apache-arrow
```

Restore the project environment and package metadata with:

```sh
make bootstrap
```

`renv.lock` is the dependency source of truth. Use `make bootstrap-qa` before
lint and package checks; do not edit the lockfile by hand.

## Validation order

Run the narrowest relevant test while developing, then use this repository-level
order before review:

```sh
make bootstrap
make bootstrap-qa
make actionlint
make lint
LOCALMAP_ALLOW_NETWORK=0 make test
LOCALMAP_ALLOW_NETWORK=0 LOCALMAP_ALLOW_LARGE_DOWNLOADS=0 R_CONFIG_ACTIVE=jc_ci TARGETS_PROFILE=ci make pipeline
make docs
make site
R_CONFIG_ACTIVE=jc_ci TARGETS_PROFILE=ci quarto render reports/paper.qmd --output-dir outputs/reports
make check
git diff --check
```

Tests are decisive: `make test` exits nonzero on any failure. The accepted
offline suite warnings describe deliberate placeholder/spatial conditions, and
the network test skips unless `LOCALMAP_ALLOW_NETWORK=1`; new warnings or skips
require investigation rather than normalization.

After the pipeline and renders, inspect maps, tables, provenance, both sites,
and the report. Follow the [workflow](workflow.md) for the required artifact
review cycle and the [layer guide](layers_guide.md) for acquisition and
provenance interpretation.

## CI notes

GitHub Actions provisions `libudunits2-dev`, `libproj-dev`, `libgdal-dev`,
`libgeos-dev`, and `libglpk-dev`, plus Pandoc through
`r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc@v2`. Local workflow edits should pass
`make actionlint` before they are proposed for CI.
